HJ-car-m-fs5.role: ablation: 2 levels, level-1 frameskip 5 (no Delta-1 level)

arms: HJ-bench (H3, matched carriers, uniform sampler, null action)
benchmarks.data: #79 CLEVRER / #84 Physion-Dominoes annotation carriers, 12 scenes each, fold all
benchmarks.metric: #79 field_errors position_mse at t in (15, 30, 60, 120) from contexts 0-3 through an R1 probe; next to #117 item-5 J (LC, full) rows

caps.stop: over the cap: stop and report

conditional.U-B3: trigger: disposition 5; our LC recipe at the B3 update count (steps x batch), 3 seeds
conditional.closed_loop: trigger: PC1 or PC2 supported for H-JEPA; GD planner live in the #104 player (#102 machinery); own engine-hour projection reported before launch

disclosures: the evaluation split was scored by earlier tickets (#101-#121) for our models; it is pristine for H-JEPA
H-JEPA's LeWM is its 4-layer re-implementation; HWM is its identity-encoder re-implementation
anchor-mixture sampler (half of every batch starts at the launch frame) is an adaptation for action-sparse data; the uniform sampler is an ablation
the level-1 ViT uses activation checkpointing (identical gradients) on 32 GB RTX 5090s
320 x 240 frames, patch 16; the 20 x 20 ViT position table is bicubic-interpolated to 15 x 20 by the official interpolate_pos_encoding path
RTX 5090 instead of H200; torch 2.13 (novphy) for the NovPhy arms, 2.7.1 (hjepa env) for the fidelity check

dispositions.1: H-JEPA ranks better than our Gate-B model (scoped) iff PC1 or PC2 is supported in the H-JEPA - U direction, G-fid, G-port and that arm's guards pass, and S10 is supported for that arm; names the arm; triggers the HJ-LC follow-up ticket
dispositions.2: our Gate-B model ranks better than H-JEPA (scoped) iff U - HJ-px and U - HJ-car-m are both supported and G-fid, G-port and every guard of both arms pass; scope: #109 sealed split, Gate-B grid cells, tie-free cost, readout R1, budgets B3 (pixels) / B1 (carriers), layout H3-Delta, Gate-B unit
dispositions.4: S5 and S11 reported next to every primary contrast (C* 0.783 vs U 0.744 at Gate B)
dispositions.5: if PC1 holds only at B3 and S7 does not: 'H-JEPA's advantage requires a larger training budget than ours'; the conditional arm U-B3 runs before any architectural reading

existing_arms.C*: LC : C-F-15, its published Gate-B records and checkpoints
existing_arms.P: the no-model action prior (Gate-B rule over the retrain fit-verdicts.json)
existing_arms.U: Gate-B unit LC : F-15-macro (hybrid, E99), its published Gate-B records (rows) and checkpoints

guards.G_action: per arm and seed: endpoint action sensitivity >= 0.05 on the fit anchors (16 grid launches)
guards.G_chronology: plan frozen_at <= readouts frozen_at <= anchors encoded_at <= first record scored_at
guards.G_collapse: per arm and seed: top-level effective rank >= 0.1 D and within-episode variance share >= 0.05
guards.G_fid: fidelity/gfid.json G_fid true (Tier E and Tier T pass)
guards.G_isolation: training / readouts read fit (and policy) only; scored branches are evaluation-roster captures; wrong anchors are fit levels
guards.G_nonfinite: per arm: <= 10 % nonfinite verdict slots on the grid cells
guards.G_readout: per arm: R1 on the true frame-min(225, last) encodings reaches pooled policy grid AUC >= 0.65
guards.G_records: records-manifest.json exists; --validate re-checks it, re-scores >= 1 record and exits 0
guards.failure: a failed guard turns every token involving the arm into readiness_or_precision_insufficient

question: does H-JEPA (arXiv 2610.06805, kevinghst/H-JEPA @ 97054ec), reproduced on NovPhy, rank the Gate-B grid candidates of the sealed #109 evaluation split better or worse than the Gate-B unit?

readouts.P_c: MLP(D->512, LN, GELU->18x3) slot presence (BCE) + engine-projected centres (MSE on present slots)
readouts.R1: MLP(D->512, LN, GELU->236) frozen top-level encodings of real fit frames -> E99 carriers (primary)
readouts.R2: same MLP on predicted endpoint latents of every fit shot (level anchor, executed launch) -> carrier at min(225, end)
readouts.R3: goal latent: mean top-level encoding of true frame min(225, end) of pig-removing fit shots; cost = squared distance
readouts.R4: R2 + 0.1 x softplus((c_success - c_failure) / 0.1) over 8 random fit mixed cells (grid, angle) per step
readouts.fit_frames: every 15th position 0..min(last, 285) of every fit shot
readouts.freeze: readouts-manifest.json (sha256 of every model.pt and readouts.pt) before any evaluation anchor is encoded
readouts.policy: every readout fit, encode and rollout under deterministic_scoring(); fit split only; policy split only for the selection AUC and the G-readout ceiling

scoring.anchors: the Gate-B anchors: carriers = its E99 batch-1 parses (anchors-evaluation.pt); pixels = frame 0 of the same anchor branches (s99.image_tensor), encoded after the readout freeze
descriptive: position MSE at t in (15, 30, 60, 150, 225) via P_c with its readout floor (P_c on the true frame encodings)
scoring.endpoint: top-level rollout of 15 steps of 15 frames (H3 / H2-fs5) or 225 steps (L1) from the level anchor; launch at frame 0, no-ops after (persist: launch every frame)
scoring.metric: Gate-B pooled grid AUC: 311 mixed grid cells x 3 seeds, tie-free cost of R1 carriers (EndpointCosts.row(R1(z_end), R1(z_0))), m99.view, member-clustered bootstrap 10000 PCG64 7201
scoring.process: one process that did not train, deterministic_scoring(), once

carriers.rule: largest policy-split pooled grid AUC under R1 at B1, seed 20260908; ties (4 d.p.) -> 0.09

pixels.rule: largest policy-split pooled grid AUC under R1 at B1, seed 20260908; ties (4 d.p.) -> 0.09

fidelity.rule: remaining runs at their measured mean GPU time (else 3 h per Tier-E eval, 6 h per Tier-T run)

token_rule: supported iff mean >= 0.02 and lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient; primary contrasts in both directions

training.precision: bf16-mixed autocast, TF32 on, cudnn.benchmark on (main_hjepa runtime settings)

recipe.optimizer: AdamW, per-level lr (5e-5 level 1, 1e-5 upper), wd 1e-3
recipe.schedule: linear warm-up over max(1, int(0.01 x steps)) then cosine to 0, per step

training.typed_failure: a NaN / nonfinite loss ends the run (model.pt complete False); never retried

wrong_anchor.pool: the 480 fit anchors (retrain anchors-fit.pt / frame 0 of the same branches)
